content.value: Six Flags Qiddiya City – Saudi Arabia’s Record-Breaking Theme Park

Experience world-class thrills at Six Flags Qiddiya City, the ultimate theme park destination in Saudi Arabia, opening near Riyadh on 31 December 2025. Spanning over 320,000 m² against the stunning Tuwaiq Mountains, this flagship attraction will redefine entertainment in the Kingdom as part of Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030.
Whether you’re seeking heart-pounding thrill rides, immersive themed zones, or family-friendly fun, Six Flags Qiddiya City brings it all together in six spectacular lands:
The Citadel:
Premium shopping, upscale dining & grand architecture.
City of Thrills:
Home to Falcon’s Flight, the world’s tallest, fastest, longest roller coaster, and Sirocco Tower, the tallest free-standing shot tower.
Discovery Springs:
Desert oasis with water attractions including Into the Deep.
Steam Town:
Industrial-themed adventures like Iron Rattler, the tallest tilt coaster.
Valley of Fortune:
Treasure hunts and Spitfire triple-launch coaster fun.
Grand Exposition:
Futuristic carnival rides including Gyrospin, the tallest pendulum ride.
Park Highlights:
✅ 28 rides & attractions for all ages
✅ 5 Guinness World Record-breaking rides
✅ 27 dining outlets + 24 retail shops
✅ Eco-friendly operations with 80% waste recycling
Book Official Tickets Online
webook.com is an authorized seller of official Six Flags Qiddiya City tickets

with secure booking, instant digital delivery, and curated bundles for families, friends, and groups. Choose from Adult (12+) or Child (4–11) tickets and enjoy full-day access to all rides and attractions.
Why Six Flags Qiddiya City Should Top Your Riyadh Itinerary:
Situated near the Saudi capital, this mega theme park is perfect for weekend getaways, family day trips, group outings, and thrill-seeker adventures.
Location:
Qiddiya City, near Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Plan Your Visit Today!
Secure your spot at the grand opening and be among the first to conquer record-breaking rides, explore immersive worlds, and make unforgettable memories.
Book your official Six Flags Qiddiya City tickets now at webook.com!

content.value: Ticketing Policy:
All tickets are strictly non-refundable, non-cancellable, and non-transferable to alternative dates.
Age & Admission Requirements:

Complimentary entry is granted to children aged 3 and under. 
Discounted rates are available for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) and Saudi Seniors (aged 60 and above).
Re-entry Policy:
Same-day re-entry is permitted, provided that guests obtain an "invisible ink" hand stamp from the Guest Operations office prior to exiting the park gates.
Safety Compliance:
Guests must strictly adhere to all height restrictions and health requirements specified for each individual ride and attraction.
Limitation of Liability:
The park management assumes no responsibility for the loss of personal property or for any damages resulting from the misuse of park facilities.
Prohibited Items:
A) General Park Entry
To ensure safety, security inspections are conducted at the entrance.
The following are generally not allowed:
Outside Food and Beverages: Most outside food and drinks are prohibited (except for specific dietary needs or baby food).
Glass Containers: Any glass items are restricted for safety reasons.
Large Bags/Suitcases: Large luggage or oversized bags may not be permitted inside the park (lockers are available for storage).
Professional Recording Equipment: Large-scale professional cameras or recording gear may require prior authorization.
Sharp Objects & Weapons: Any items that could be used as a weapon are strictly prohibited.
B) Prohibited Items on Rides (Safety Restrictions)
For your safety and the safety of others, "loose items" are prohibited on most rides:
Accessories: Dangly earrings, loose jewelry, and unsecured accessories.
Clothing with Hazards: Garments with sharp buckles, rivets, or metal studs.

Loose Footwear: Shoes that slip off easily (like flip-flops) are prohibited on "gravity-defying" rides. 
secure, lace-up sports shoes are recommended.
Personal Electronics: Phones and cameras must be secured in lockers or left with a non-rider.
C) Dress Code & Local Customs
While not "items," the following dress code restrictions apply:
Modesty: Visitors are requested to dress modestly in respect of local customs (covering shoulders and knees).

Ride Safety: Overly loose or flowing garments (like long scarves or unsecured traditional dress) 
may prevent access to certain rides where they could get caught in machinery.
Family-Friendly: Clothing should be appropriate for a family environment.
D) Prohibited Conduct
Smoking: Restricted to designated areas only.
Unsupervised Children: Children must be supervised, and small children must wear swimming diapers in water-based attractions.
Note: If you arrive with prohibited items, the park provides locker rentals at the entrance and near major attractions for safekeeping. (For extra charges)

data.title: Six Flags Qiddiya City
data.description:
Six Flags Qiddiya City is the Kingdom’s premier theme park destination, designed to be a global beacon of entertainment, adrenaline, and imagination. Spanning 320,000 m² against the dramatic backdrop of the Tuwaiq Mountains, the park seamlessly blends record-breaking thrills with immersive storytelling and family-friendly adventures.


The park is organized into six uniquely themed lands, each offering a distinct atmosphere and experience:

1. The Citadel
As the grand gateway to the park, The Citadel is a vibrant hub that welcomes guests with impressive architecture, high-end retail, and premium dining. It serves as the heart of the park, connecting all other zones and offering a sophisticated space to gather before or after a day of adventure.

2. City of Thrills
This zone is the crown jewel for adrenaline seekers. It captures the essence of Saudi Arabia’s "Vision 2030" spirit of progress and speed. It is home to the park's most iconic attraction:
Falcon’s Flight: The world’s tallest, fastest, and longest roller coaster.
Sirocco Tower: The world’s tallest free-standing shot tower.

3. Discovery Springs
A refreshing oasis inspired by the relationship between the desert and water. This zone focuses on interactive play and aquatic-themed adventures.
Key Attraction: Into the Deep, an interactive dark ride that takes guests into mysterious underwater caves.

4. Steam Town
Where the past meets a mechanical future, Steam Town is a rustic, industrial-themed land centered around the "Iron Rattler Mining Company." It features high-energy mechanical rides and rugged dining options.
Key Attraction: Iron Rattler, the world’s tallest tilt coaster, offering a heart-stopping vertical drop.

5. Valley of Fortune
Inspired by the era of exploration and the search for hidden treasures, this land is set amidst ancient ruins and desert landscapes. It offers a sense of mystery and grand-scale adventure.
Key Attraction: Spitfire, a record-shredding triple-launch coaster that mimics the maneuvers of a stunt plane.

6. Grand Exposition
Celebrating the ingenuity of science and invention, this zone is styled after a world’s fair. It combines nostalgic charm with futuristic concepts, featuring classic carnival-style attractions reimagined with cutting-edge technology.
Key Attraction: Gyrospin, the world’s tallest pendulum ride.

Park Highlights & Stats:
Total Attractions: 28 rides and attractions (10 thrill rides, 18 family-friendly).

World Records: Home to 5 world-record-breaking rides.

Lifestyle & Dining: 27 global dining outlets and 24 unique retail shops.

Sustainability: Committed to the environment, with a goal of recycling over 80% of operational waste.

Six Flags Qiddiya City is more than a theme park; it is a "City of Play" that offers a holistic experience where world-class entertainment meets the rich heritage and ambitious future of Saudi Arabia.

content.value: Experience the excitement of the World Cup like never before at “Live the World Cup” inside Abadi Aljohar Arena ⚽🔥

Giant screens, interactive zones, challenges and prizes, an unforgettable fan atmosphere, restaurants & cafés, and a football experience that keeps the excitement alive from the first whistle to the final minute.
Whether you’re coming with friends or family, this is where you’ll truly live the World Cup spirit in the heart of Jeddah’s vibrant atmosphere.
Book your ticket now and get ready for one of Saudi Arabia’s biggest football fan gatherings.

schedule.title: Live the World Cup: The Grand Final with Benchmark

content.value: In purchasing this ticket, you agree to abide by all the terms and conditions and adhere to any other responsible terms and conditions or restrictions provided by the organizer before or during the event:
Open gate 6:00 PM
Start match 10:00 PM
Every attendee must purchase a separate ticket.
The Age allowed is 6 years and older.
Tickets prices are non-refundable.
In case of event cancellation, postponing or changing the date by the event organizer, the ticket price will be refunded.

The ticket holder is solely responsible for checking the date, time, location, and the age restriction of the event. Early arrival is a must, and the organizer shall have the right to refuse any late entries, and the ticket holder shall not have the right to claim for a refund of the ticket price or any compensation whatsoever.
In case of leaving the venue, you are not allowed to return.

All tickets holders and their belongings may be subject to search when entering the venue. Prohibited and dangerous items will be confiscated. Any item which the organizer or venue security personnel consider as security risk or that may be used to damage the venue or interfere with the event will be confiscated.
Food and beverages from outside are not allowed. Food trucks will be available.
Animals are not allowed.
No professional cameras and video recorders are permitted at the venue.
The ticket holder consents to photographs, video, audio recordings of ticket holder be captured and used in printed and electronics media, including the internet as an attendee at the venue.

The organizer accepts no liability for bodily injury, illness, or death of any visitor (including ticket holder) and / or loss of or damage to personal effects arising out of or in connection with the event.
The organizer has the right to remove whoever commits an act that, in the opinion of the organizer, is a contrary behavior.
Adherence to the rules of public taste in line with the culture, values, and tradition of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
Adherence to Modest Clothing
It is required to comply with the general guidelines and dress code rules as per the Public Decency Regulations. These guidelines include:

- Clothing should not be transparent, body-colored, or tight to the point of revealing body details.  
- Wearing clothing that has phrases, images, or patterns that are offensive to public morals, or showing tattoos that conflict with public decency is prohibited.  
- Clothing with phrases, images, or patterns that promote racism, divisive ideologies, drug use, or obscenity should not be worn.  
- Wearing underwear, sleepwear, or similar items as outerwear is not permitted.  
- Clothing should not be tight in sensitive areas; if tight clothing is necessary for presentation, the sensitive areas must be covered with additional fabric in both the front and back to ensure they are not visible.  
- For women, clothing should be at least knee-length.  
- Sleeves should cover the chest, back, and shoulders for women.  
- Wearing inappropriate clothing is prohibited. Clothing rules should follow the example set in the Public Decency Regulations under Ministerial Resolution No. 10166 by the Ministry of Interior.
These rules aim to preserve public morals and mutual respect within the community. Adherence to such standards reflects the values of society and promotes positive behavior.

The ticket purchaser acknowledges that the event organizer has the right to add, modify, or replace any artistic segments, accompanying performances, emerging talents, or guest artists within the event program without the prior consent of the ticket holder. Such changes shall not be considered a material change to the event as long as the main advertised artist remains part of the performance. Accordingly, the ticket holder shall not be entitled to request a refund or compensation, unless the organizer decides otherwise at its sole discretion or as required under applicable laws and regulations.

The event organizer reserves the right to change the start time of the concert or rearrange the event schedule whenever deemed necessary for the benefit of the event or due to organizational, technical, or operational reasons. Such changes shall not be considered a cancellation of the event nor entitle the ticket holder to a refund, provided that the event takes place on the same date and at the same advertised venue, unless the organizer decides otherwise or applicable laws and regulations require otherwise.

HOSPITALITY SALES REGULATIONSFOR PURCHASE VIA WEBOOK.COM
1. Purpose and Applicability of the Sales Regulations

1.1 These Sales Regulations outline the terms and conditions which apply to, and govern, the sale through the Website and use of Hospitality Packages for the AFC Asian Cup Saudi Arabia 2027™, which are being made available by WeBook directly to the Customer via the Website. MATCH Hospitality has authorised WeBook to act as its agent solely in connection with the sale and distribution of Hospitality Packages. MATCH Hospitality has also authorised WeBook to make Hospitality Packages available for purchase via the Website.

1.2 By agreeing to purchase any Hospitality Packages from WeBook, and as a condition of any purchase of any Hospitality Packages from WeBook, the Customer further irrevocably and unconditionally agrees with MATCH Hospitality (under a separate legally binding agreement) to these Sales Regulations and the Additional Terms. Each Customer acknowledges and agrees that, by (i) completing the Application Process, and (ii) clicking the Acceptance of Terms and Conditions Box, the Customer confirms that it has read, understood and accepts these Sales Regulations and, subject to Section 9, the Additional Terms, and that it agrees to be irrevocably and unconditionally bound by these Sales Regulations and the Additional Terms. For the avoidance of doubt, these Sales Regulations form an integral part, and are a binding component, of any agreement between WeBook and the Customer in relation to the purchase of Hospitality Packages by the Customer, and by clicking the Acceptance of Terms and Conditions Box the Customer agrees with MATCH Hospitality, under a separate legally binding agreement, to be bound by these Sales Regulations and the Additional Terms. The terms and conditions contained in these Sales Regulations shall, in any case, prevail over any other terms that the Customer may seek to impose or incorporate under its agreement with MATCH Hospitality, or which are implied by custom, practice or course of dealing. Any such other terms shall be deemed rejected by MATCH Hospitality.

1.3 MATCH Hospitality reserves the right to amend the manner in which it sells Hospitality Packages, and reserves the right to amend these Sales Regulations from time to time. Each Sales Agreement will be governed by the Sales Regulations in force at the date on which the Customer completes the Application Process and clicks the Acceptance of Terms and Conditions Box. MATCH Hospitality may also at any time and without notice change the scope, pricing and availability of future Hospitality Package product offerings.
1.4 All capitalised terms used in these Sales Regulations shall have the meaning ascribed to them in Section 17.
2. Transaction Details
2.1 WeBook has an allocation of Hospitality Packages that it is entitled to make available directly to Customers in accordance with an agreement with MATCH Hospitality.

2.2 Other than as specifically described in these Sales Regulations with respect to the Hospitality Packages provided by MATCH Hospitality, the financial and commercial terms, conditions and requirements under which WeBook makes Hospitality Packages available to the Customer are determined by WeBook (at its sole discretion) and agreed between WeBook and the Customer.

2.3 The Customer acknowledges and agrees that MATCH Hospitality has no involvement, responsibility or liability for any ancillary service transactions (such as travel, accommodation or other amenities) which the Customer may secure from WeBook and any such transactions are subject to separate arrangements agreed between WeBook and the Customer.

2.4 WeBook has the obligation to ensure that: (a) the MATCH Hospitality official prices of the Hospitality Packages are disclosed to the Customer; (b) the Customer is informed that Hospitality Packages can always be purchased separately from any other ancillary services, and WeBook is prohibited from requiring the Customer to buy any other ancillary services as a condition for the purchase of official Hospitality Packages; and (c) all Hospitality Packages governed by these Sales Regulations will be delivered by WeBook to the Customer. Customer should promptly contact MATCH Hospitality directly if WeBook has not acted in compliance with these requirements.

2.5 The Customer acknowledges and agrees that the Application Process involves a number of steps including but not limited to: (i) creating an account with the Website, (ii) providing payment details to WeBook via the Website, (iii) completing and submitting an Order Form to WeBook via the Website, and (iv) clicking the Acceptance of Terms and Conditions Box.
3. [DELETED]
4. The Sales Agreement
4.1 Subject to Section 9, each Customer irrevocably agrees, acknowledges and undertakes to comply with:
i. these Sales Regulations;
ii. the Ticket GTCs; and
iii. the Stadium Code of Conduct.

4.2 Any other samples, drawings, descriptive matter or advertising issued by MATCH Hospitality or WeBook (whether or not on the Website), and any illustrations or descriptions of the Hospitality Packages contained in WeBook’ or MATCH Hospitality's catalogues or brochures are issued, displayed or published for the sole purpose of giving an approximate idea of the Hospitality Packages, and shall not, under any circumstance, constitute an offer or public offer by MATCH Hospitality. They shall not form part of the Sales Agreement or have any contractual force.

4.3 WeBook is the principal in the sale of Hospitality Packages to Customers; provided that the Customer hereby accepts pursuant to any sale agreement between WeBook and the Customer, a direct contractual relationship with MATCH Hospitality concerning the supply of the Hospitality Package and acknowledges that, based on this direct relationship between MATCH Hospitality and Customer with respect to Hospitality Packages, MATCH Hospitality has the right to exercise any of the rights and remedies with respect to the Hospitality Package, pursuant to these Sales Regulations The Customer further acknowledges and agrees, however, that MATCH Hospitality has been authorised by the AFC to provide, as an agent for the AFC, a Ticket to the Customer as an integral part of each Hospitality Package and that the AFC, upon MATCH Hospitality’s notification to the AFC of the sale of Hospitality Packages to Customers, automatically becomes the principal in the sale of the Ticket being part of a Hospitality Package. The Customer hereby accepts this direct contractual relationship with the AFC concerning the sale of the Ticket being part of the Hospitality Package and acknowledges that, based on this direct relationship between the AFC and Customer with respect to Tickets, the AFC has the right to exercise any of the rights and remedies with respect to Tickets pursuant to the Ticket GTCs and the Stadium Code of Conduct.

4.4 The Customer acknowledges and agrees that WeBook has no power or authority to make any representations, commitments, promises, guarantees, warranties or undertakings on behalf of MATCH Hospitality and/or the AFC, or to bind MATCH Hospitality and/or the AFC in any way. These Sales Regulations represent the sole and complete statement of the respective rights and obligations of MATCH Hospitality and the Customer in connection with the supply of the Hospitality Packages.
5. Hospitality Packages

5.1 The scope of the services and benefits made available to the Customer by MATCH Hospitality in respect of each Hospitality Package will be outlined in the Product Description. Neither the Customer nor WeBook may request substitutions for, or alterations to, any Hospitality Package services and benefits. Customers may contact WeBook or MATCH Hospitality directly with any questions about the Product Descriptions.

5.2 The Customer accepts and acknowledges that the scope of the Hospitality Package services and benefits made available to it are subject to such changes as may be required for reasons of public safety and security, or as may be reasonably determined by MATCH Hospitality and/or the AFC, from time to time. WeBook shall notify the Customer of such changes as soon as reasonably possible.

5.3 Certain hospitality benefits and/or services may be delivered by MATCH Hospitality in Hospitality Facilities which are located in temporary hospitality structures and/or in the Stadium in respect of which construction may not be completed as at the date the Customer secures the Hospitality Packages from WeBook. In either circumstance, detailed descriptions of the applicable Hospitality Facility will be provided by MATCH Hospitality as and when practicable.

5.4 The Customer and each of its Guests are required to bring with them, on the applicable Match day, both the Ticket and the Hospitality Access Pass to enable them to access a seat to view the Match and to access the Hospitality Facilities, together with any additional or alternative document, pass or form of identification that are notified to the Customer in order for the Customer and each of its guests to access such seats and Hospitality Facilities. In the event that the Hospitality Access Pass and/or the Ticket is to be made available for collection at the venue rather than delivered to the Customer by WeBook, the Customer should be notified in advance by WeBook.

5.5 Customers who require special assistance due to a disability (including but not limited to wheelchair seating and/or wheelchair access to Hospitality Facilities and/or a Stadium) must notify WeBook prior to securing a Hospitality Package. In the event that any Customer subsequently wishes to provide a Hospitality Package to a person who requires any special assistance due to a disability, the Customer shall promptly notify WeBook as soon as reasonably practical and MATCH Hospitality, having been notified by WeBook, will use reasonable efforts to provide such special assistance (subject to availability).

5.6 Subject to the Product Description, the Customer acknowledges and agrees that parking passes (i) are subject to availability and final confirmation by MATCH Hospitality (ii) must be specifically requested in writing by the Customer and (iii) will, unless MATCH Hospitality determines otherwise (at its sole discretion), be allocated on the basis of one (1) automobile space per Match for every four (4) Hospitality Packages purchased per Match or one (1) bus space per Match for every forty (40) Hospitality Packages purchased per Match.

5.7 The Customer acknowledges and agrees that the stadium at which any Match(es) are scheduled to be played is determined by the LOC and/or the AFC and may be amended at any time prior to the relevant Match(es).

5.7.1 If, as a result of any decision, directive or requirement of the LOC, AFC, AFC authority, stadium authority or for operational, safety, security or regulatory reasons, the venue of a Match is changed from one stadium to another stadium, MATCH Hospitality Asia shall be entitled to allocate and/or transfer the Customer to the stadium officially designated to host such Match(es).
5.7.2 In connection with any such change of venue, MATCH Hospitality Asia shall have the right to:
i. transfer the Customer to the replacement stadium hosting the relevant Match(es);
ii. substitute the purchased Hospitality Package with a comparable or reasonably equivalent hospitality product for the same Match(es) at the replacement stadium; and/or

iii. reallocate the Customer within the same or an alternative hospitality product category in respect of the same Match(es), where reasonably required for operational, regulatory, commercial or rights-holder compliance reasons.

5.7.3 MATCH Hospitality Asia shall use reasonable endeavours to ensure that any substituted or reallocated hospitality product is of a comparable standard and value for the relevant Match(es). Any price adjustment (whether increase or reduction) arising directly from such change of venue or reallocation shall be calculated by reference to the applicable official price list for the relevant stadium and hospitality product. Save for any such price adjustment, the Customer shall not be entitled to cancel the Sales Agreement or claim any compensation, damages or losses arising from a change of stadium or related reallocation made in accordance with this Clause.

5.8 The Customer acknowledges that the Hospitality Package price is an all-inclusive price, which includes food, beverage and which may also include gift products, which are not typically served at the Stadium and are not capable of being separately priced or sold as individual servings.
6. [DELETED]
7. Delivery of Hospitality Package Components

7.1 Provided the Customer has paid in full for the Hospitality Packages allocated to it, the Customer’s Hospitality Access Passes, Tickets, any parking pass and all other applicable Hospitality Package components will be:
i. delivered by MATCH Hospitality to WeBook for onward distribution to the Customer; or

ii. made available for collection by WeBook for onward distribution to the Customer at MATCH Hospitality customer service centres, in accordance with policies to be established by MATCH Hospitality and notified to the Customer by WeBook; or
iii. made available for collection at an alternative location if this is notified in advance to the Customer by WeBook.

7.2 The Customer acknowledges and agrees that the delivery or the availability for collection, of Hospitality Package components is subject to the Customer having complied in full with all elements of the Sales Regulations. MATCH Hospitality may, in its sole discretion, elect to deliver Hospitality Packages directly to the Customer.

7.3 MATCH Hospitality shall not be responsible on behalf of any Customer or Guest for applying for collecting or providing any travel visa or substitutional permits (including any form of fan identification system such as a fan passport or equivalent document or permit) to enter or exit the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

7.4 Neither MATCH Hospitality nor WeBook will be responsible or liable in any way to a Customer or any third party as a result of any late delivery of a Hospitality Package which arises as a result of a failure of and/or interruption to any delivery services or failure, act or omission of any third party supplier or local authority or government department.

7.5 The Customer is required to provide WeBook with a street address as well as the name and contact details of an individual which has been expressly authorised to take delivery of the Hospitality Packages. It is the Customer's responsibility to arrange for an authorised representative to be present at the delivery address to take delivery of every Hospitality Package and to notify WeBook of any change in the proposed delivery address.

7.6 Any Ticket, Hospitality Access Pass or parking pass which has become damaged in any way after delivery to, or collection by, the Customer and is, as a consequence, unreadable, may not be accepted for admission to, or use at, a Stadium and/or Hospitality Facility. It is the sole responsibility of the Customer to immediately notify WeBook, in writing, in the event that any Ticket, Hospitality Access Pass or parking pass is delivered or collected in a damaged condition. In the absence of any such written notification, the relevant Ticket, Hospitality Access Pass or parking pass will be deemed to be undamaged at delivery or collection.

7.7 The AFC, MATCH Hospitality and WeBook shall not be responsible or liable in any way to a Customer or any third party for any lost, stolen, damaged, destroyed, forgotten or mutilated Ticket, Hospitality Access Pass or parking passes or other Hospitality Package component once received or collected by the Customer.

7.8 MATCH Hospitality reserves the right to determine whether to issue replacement Hospitality Access Passes, Tickets or parking passes in the event of any occurrence of the circumstances outlined in Sections 7.5, 7.6 and/or 7.7, and to determine the conditions which may apply to any such replacements. MATCH Hospitality reserves the right to determine the conditions which shall apply to the replacement Hospitality Access Passes, Tickets or Parking Passes in the event of any occurrence of the circumstances outlined in Sections 7.5, 7.6 and/or 7.7.
8. Hospitality Services
8.1 The Customer acknowledges and agrees that:

i. access to any Stadium and/or Hospitality Facilities is strictly limited to the day of the Match in respect of which a Hospitality Package has been purchased, and to the times indicated by MATCH Hospitality from time to time;

ii. the delivery of all hospitality services and benefits in connection with a Hospitality Package are subject to applicable laws. By way of illustration only, and without limitation, it may be that there is a general prohibition on the serving of alcoholic beverages at certain Stadium and/or Hospitality Facilities other than at certain times;

iii. MATCH Hospitality retains the right to amend the scope of the Hospitality Facilities and hospitality services and benefits applicable to any Hospitality Package, provided that MATCH Hospitality provides the Customer with replacement hospitality services and benefits of substantially similar or better quality and value;
iv. access to Hospitality Facilities will be limited to Customers and Guests who are in possession of appropriate Hospitality Access Passes; and

v. MATCH Hospitality will use reasonable efforts to procure that Tickets which form part of Hospitality Packages which are the subject of a single transaction between the Customer and WeBook will, wherever reasonably possible, correspond to Stadium seats which are adjacent to each other or in the same block. No guarantees or warranties are provided by MATCH Hospitality that seats will be adjacent to each other or in the same block.
9. Ticket GTCs and the Stadium Code of Conduct

9.1 The Ticket GTCs, the Stadium Code of Conduct and these Sales Regulations each form an integral part of the transaction between the Customer and WeBook, and the Customer irrevocably and unconditionally undertakes and agrees to fully comply with the Ticket GTCs, the Stadium Code of Conduct and these Sales Regulations. The Ticket GTCs and Stadium Code of Conduct comprise the version to which the Customer agrees to be bound at the date the Customer transacts with WeBook and as amended from time to time. The Customer agrees to accept and comply with any updated version of the Ticket GTCs and Stadium Code of Conduct issued subsequently. Each Customer and Guest who uses a Ticket to enter the Stadium will be deemed to have fully and irrevocably agreed to accept, and comply with, the Stadium Code of Conduct

9.2 The Customer further agrees to ensure that its Guests fully comply with the Ticket GTCs, the Stadium Code of Conduct and these Sales Regulations and the Customer, regardless of the Customer’s fault, remains primarily liable to MATCH Hospitality for any non-compliance by the Guest. The Customer shall also remain directly liable to the AFC for any non-compliance by it or its Guest(s) of the Ticket GTCs or the Stadium Code of Conduct. It is the Customer's responsibility to notify to each individual Guest in writing of the requirements of the Ticket GTCs, the Stadium Code of Conduct and these Sales Regulations and to ensure full compliance with the same by its Guests.

9.3 All of the terms and conditions reflected in the Ticket GTCs and these Sales Regulations with respect to the Stadium to which a Ticket Holder gains access through the use of a Ticket shall also apply to the Hospitality Facilities, in so far as is relevant, to which the Customer gains access through the use of Hospitality Access Pass on Match days.

9.4 With respect to a Ticket which comprises part of a Hospitality Package, any reference to the “Ticket Applicant” in the Ticket GTCs shall be considered a reference to the Customer, and any reference to the “Ticket Holder” in the Ticket GTCs shall be considered a reference to the Customer and/or the Guest to whom the Customer provides a Ticket which forms part of a Hospitality Package.

9.5 Any measures taken or imposed by the AFC Authority with respect to any Match, any Ticket or any Stadium shall apply to the Customer and/or its Guests. By way of illustration only, if any Ticket is cancelled or a Customer or Guest is expelled from, or refused entrance to, the Stadium and/or the Hospitality Facilities as a result of a violation of the Ticket GTCs, the Stadium Code of Conduct or these Sales Regulations or as result of any action authorised pursuant to any law or by-law, the Customer and/or the Guest may (without prejudice to any other rights or remedies MATCH Hospitality may have) lose all rights pursuant to its Hospitality Package(s) (including the Ticket component), with no right of refund.

9.6 The locations of seats for specific Ticket categories for Matches at the Stadiums are determined by the AFC in its discretion. MATCH Hospitality shall not be responsible or liable in any way to a Customer and/or any Guests in relation to any complaints regarding locations of seats provided the locations of such seats correspond with the correct Ticket category for the particular Match at the relevant Stadium.
10. Data

10.1 The Customer agrees that it shall comply with the directives of the AFC and the competent Saudi authorities with regard to the provision of individual or personal data for Guests. Not limiting the generality thereof, the Customer shall, in particular, provide MATCH Hospitality, immediately following any request by MATCH Hospitality, the AFC, any Saudi authority and/or any third party authorised by the AFC or by the applicable laws, with full details relating to its identity and the identity of each of its Guests, including but not limited to the Guest’s name, passport/identity card numbers, nationality and date of birth and such other information and/or data as the AFC or MATCH Hospitality may require from time to time. The Customer agrees, if requested by MATCH Hospitality, to provide each of its Guests with the Ticket specifically allocated, by Ticket number or by block, seat or row number, to such Guest.

10.2 In the event that the Customer fails to provide the details set out in Section 10.1, MATCH Hospitality reserves the right (without prejudice to any other rights or remedies MATCH Hospitality may have) to withhold delivery of the Hospitality Packages until such data is provided, to cancel the relevant Hospitality Package(s) and/or to refuse entrance to the Stadium and/or any Hospitality Facility to any Customer or Guest for which data has not been provided, with no right to any refund. The Customer acknowledges and agrees that any Ticket and any other component of a Hospitality Package(s) thus cancelled may be made available for re-sale by MATCH Hospitality.

10.3 MATCH Hospitality or the AFC Authority may carry out access controls and inspects at a Stadium. The Customer acknowledges its responsibility to obtain the consent of each Guest to use his personal data for the purposes described above.
10.5 Customers may update, correct or amend their personal data by contacting WeBook in writing.
11. Prohibition on the Resale and Transfer of Hospitality Packages
11.1 The Customer is prohibited from:
i. directly or indirectly conducting, allowing, permitting, authorising and/or approving:
a. any re-sale, or the offering for resale (whether online or offline), and/or

of any Hospitality Package, Ticket, Hospitality Access Pass, parking pass or other benefit or service provided in connection with a Hospitality Package, whether for any value of any kind or otherwise, including, without limitation, in connection with any separate transaction with any third party under which any value of any kind is transferred to the Customer in connection (whether direct or indirect) with the provision by the Customer of any Hospitality Package;

12.4 The Customer shall not, and shall ensure that each of its Guests shall not, develop, use or register any name, logo, trademark, symbol, service mark or other mark (including without limitation the official name and mascot of the AFC Asian Cup Saudi Arabia 2027™) which may be inferred by the public as identifying with the AFC, AFC Asian Cup Saudi Arabia 2027™ or the LOC, including the words “Asian Cup”, “the AFC”, (or any other term used in any language to identify the AFC Asian Cup Saudi Arabia 2027™).

12.5 The Customer shall not, and shall ensure that each of its Guests shall not, bring or cause to have brought any promotional, advertising or commercial items of any kind into a Stadium or Hospitality Facility, including any banner, sign or leaflet for the purposes of display or distribution. 12.7 The Customer agrees and acknowledges that any violation by Customer and/or its Guests of the terms relating to the use of Hospitality Package pursuant to Clauses 12.1 to 12.6 above represents a material breach of these Sales Regulations by Customer. In such case:
i. WeBook is entitled to terminate with immediate effect the transaction with the Customer for the purchase of Hospitality Packages pursuant to Section 15.2 below;

TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, THE CUSTOMER AND EACH GUEST INDEMNIFIES AND HOLDS HARMLESS MATCH HOSPITALITY, WEBOOK AND THE AFC AUTHORITIES FROM AND AGAINST ANY AND ALL CLAIMS, DAMAGES AND LIABILITIES SUFFERED AND/OR INCURRED IN CONNECTION WITH, ARISING OUT OF OR RESULTING FROM:
i. ITS MISUSE OF A TICKET AND/OR HOSPITALITY ACCESS PASS; OR
ii. THE MISUSE OF A TICKET AND/OR HOSPITALITY ACCESS PASS BY A MINOR IF THE TICKET AND/OR HOSPITALITY ACCESS PASS WAS PROVIDED BY THE CUSTOMER; OR
iii. THE MISUSE OF A TICKET AND/OR HOSPITALITY ACCESS PASS BY ANY OTHER THIRD PARTY WHICH HAS OBTAINED, DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY, A TICKET AND/OR HOSPITALITY ACCESS PASS THROUGH IT; OR
iv. A VIOLATION OF THE TICKET GTCS, THESE SALES REGULATIONS, THE STADIUM CODE OF CONDUCT AND/OR ANY OTHER RELEVANT LAWS OR BY-LAWS; OR
v. ANY OTHER HARMFUL CONDUCT IN CONNECTION WITH THE TICKET AND/OR HOSPITALITY ACCESS PASS.

13.7 THIS MEANS THAT IF A CUSTOMER OR ANY GUEST VIOLATES ANY TICKET AND/OR HOSPITALITYACCESS PASS RELATED RULES, THE CUSTOMER MUST TAKE FULL FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITY AND PAY FOR ANY DAMAGE, INCLUDING LEGAL COSTS, THAT MATCH HOSPITALITY, WEBOOK AND/OR THE AFC AUTHORITIES MAY INCUR IN MANAGING OR RESOLVING THE PROBLEMS CAUSED BY THE VIOLATION.

13.8 THE CUSTOMER AND EACH GUEST IS RESPONSIBLE FOR THEIR PERSONAL ARRANGEMENTS CONNECTED TO THE HOSPITALITY PACKAGES (INCLUDING, WITHOUT LIMITATION, TRAVEL AND ACCOMMODATION) AND SUCH ARRANGEMENTS ARE ENTERED INTO BY THE CUSTOMER AND EACH GUEST AT THEIR OWN RISK AND MATCH HOSPITALITY SHALL NOT BE LIABLE FOR ANY COSTS OR LOSSES RELATING TO SUCH ARRANGEMENTS SUFFERED BY THE CUSTOMER AND ANY GUESTS.
14. Unforeseen Circumstances

14.1 If a Match is rescheduled or relocated owing to a Force Majeure Event, MATCH Hospitality shall use reasonable efforts to arrange for corresponding hospitality services and benefits to be provided at the rescheduled or relocated Match, but will have no obligation to do so. MATCH Hospitality reserves the right to make alterations to the times, dates and locations in connection with the delivery of hospitality benefits and services as a result of any such unforeseen circumstances.

14.2 Regardless of the availability of hospitality services and benefits, the rescheduling or relocation of any Match owing to a Force Majeure Event or another circumstance outside the control of MATCH Hospitality does not affect the validity of any Ticket for that Match (other than as specified in the Ticket GTCs). Tickets are exclusively governed by the Ticket GTCs with respect to the rescheduling or relocation of any Match.

14.3 If a Match or any part thereof is cancelled due to a Force Majeure Event (including but not limited to a safety and security concern or a decision made by the AFC, WeBook or any other the AFC Authority or the disqualification or withdrawal of a team), MATCH Hospitality shall refund to WeBook a portion of the price of each affected Hospitality Package, such refund to be determined by reference to the prevailing circumstances (and to be subject to the deduction of all unrecoverable costs). Any such refund shall constitute the sole and exclusive remedy to which WeBook is entitled. WeBook should provide the benefit of the refund to the Customer.

14.4 The cancellation of any Match or part thereof due to a Force Majeure Event (including but not limited to a as safety and security concern or a decision made by the AFC, the LOC or any other the AFC Authority, or the disqualification or withdrawal of a team) does not affect the validity of any Ticket for that Match (other than as specified in the Ticket GTCs). Tickets are exclusively governed by the Ticket GTCs with respect to the cancellation of any Match.
15. Termination

15.1 The Customer agrees and acknowledges that, in the event of a violation or breach of any term of the Ticket GTCs, these Sales Regulations, the Stadium Code of Conduct or any other relevant laws or by-laws, MATCH Hospitality shall, in addition to all other rights and remedies that MATCH Hospitality may have, retain the right to:
i. terminate the agreement for the provision of Hospitality Packages in whole or in part immediately without further notice;
ii. render null and void any applicable Hospitality Access Pass;
iii. enforce the AFC’s termination of the sale of the Ticket being part of the Hospitality Package and the AFC’s right to render null and void the Ticket(s) comprised in the Hospitality Package;
iv. refuse entry into the Stadium and/or any Hospitality Facility to the offending Customer and/or Guest, or eject the Customer and/or Guest from the Stadium and/or Hospitality Facility;
v. enforce these Sales Regulations and/or claim damages; and/or

vi. notify governmental authorities of a violation of the provisions of the Ticket GTCs, these Sales Regulations, Stadium Code of Conduct, and/or the relevant laws or by-laws that correspond to violations of applicable criminal or other laws.

15.2 The Customer agrees and acknowledges that, in the event of a violation or breach of any term of the Ticket GTCs, or the Stadium Code of Conduct or any other relevant laws or by-laws, the AFC, or MATCH Hospitality acting on the AFC’s behalf, shall, in addition to all other rights and remedies that the AFC may have, retain the right to:
i. terminate, in whole or in part, the direct agreement between the AFC and the Customer concerning the sales of the Ticket being part of the Hospitality Package;
ii. cancel, or render null and void, any Ticket being part of the Hospitality Package; and/or
iii. refuse entry into the Stadium and/or any Hospitality Facility to the offending Customer and/or Guest, or eject the Customer and/or Guest from the Stadium and/or Hospitality Facility.
15.3 The Customer agrees and acknowledges that:

i. MATCH Hospitality shall be entitled to terminate, in whole or in part, the agreement for the provision of Hospitality Packages if the AFC has exercised any of its rights set out in Section 15.3 above; and

ii. the AFC shall be entitled to terminate the direct agreement between the AFC and the Customer concerning the sale of a Ticket being part of the Hospitality Package if MATCH Hospitality has exercised any of its rights set out under Section 15.2 above.

15.4 In addition to laws applicable in other countries, the Saudi government may enact laws or regulations that make it a criminal offence to transfer and/or use Tickets or Hospitality Access Passes in violation of the Ticket GTCs, these Sales Regulations, the Stadium Code of Conduct, or any other relevant laws or by-laws. Customers and their Guests are advised to obtain information about applicable laws relating to Tickets and Hospitality Access Passes.
16. Miscellaneous

16.1 Should any provision(s) of these Sales Regulations be declared void, ineffective or unenforceable by any competent court, the remainder of the Sales Regulations will remain in effect as if such void, ineffective or unenforceable provision(s) had not been contained.

16.2 These Sales Regulations (together with its component parts) has been drafted in English. The Ticket GTCs may be translated into the Arabic, and made available through the AFC.com. In the event of any discrepancy between the English and other language version of these Sales Regulations and the GTCs, the English text will prevail and will be used to resolve all questions of interpretation and application.

16.3 Certain provisions of the Ticket GTCs and these Sales Regulations may be restated in a condensed format so that they may be printed, respectively, within the confined space allocated on the back of each Ticket and the Hospitality Passes. In the event of any doubt regarding the scope or meaning of the condensed provisions of the Ticket GTCs as located on the reverse side of any Ticket and these Sales Regulations as located on the reverse side of any Hospitality Passes, the full terms of the Ticket GTCs and these Sales Regulations will apply and will prevail over the condensed provisions.

16.4 MATCH Hospitality reserves the right to refuse (at its sole discretion) the purchase of Hospitality Packages by Customers who are the subject of football match banning orders or who are identified by the AFC as being prohibited from any such purchase.

16.5 If there is any inconsistency between the provisions of these Sales Regulations and the Ticket GTCs with respect to any matter pertaining to the use of a Ticket at a Stadium, the Ticket GTCs shall apply and will prevail over the terms of the Sales Regulations.

16.6 To the fullest extent allowed by applicable law, and in the absence of amicable settlement, any disputes arising out of or in connection with these Sales Regulations and/or the Ticket sales agreement with the AFC pursuant to Section 4.2 above shall, unless otherwise determined by MATCH Hospitality or the AFC (if applicable), be resolved exclusively by arbitration in accordance with the rules of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

16.7 The Customer agrees to indemnify and hold harmless MATCH Hospitality and WeBook and the AFC Authorities, as well as their respective officers, directors, employees, representatives or agents against any and all liabilities, obligations, losses, damages, penalties, claims, fines and expenses (including reasonable legal expenses) resulting from, arising directly out of, or directly attributable to:
i. any claim by any Guest against MATCH Hospitality (or WeBook) or the AFC Authority in connection with any purported breach by MATCH Hospitality of these Sales Regulations;

ii. any activity conducted by the Customer or any of its Guests which causes damage to MATCH Hospitality (or WeBook) or the AFC Authority or to the enjoyment of Hospitality Packages by any other Customer or Guest; and
iii. any activity conducted by the Customer or any of its Guests which infringes the intellectual property rights of MATCH Hospitality and/or the AFC.

16.8 A notice under or in connection with these Sales Regulations must be in writing and must be delivered personally or sent by overnight mail delivery service or by fax or by PDF attached to an email to the party due to receive the notice at its address or to another address specified by the receiving party by written notice to the other party.

16.9 These Sales Regulations shall not be amended or modified, and no provision hereof shall be deemed to have been waived by either party, except by a written instrument signed by both MATCH Hospitality and the Customer.
17. Definitions

17.1 “Acceptance of Terms and Conditions Box” means the tick box located on the Website which reads substantially as follows: “I hereby accept and will comply with the WeBook Sales Regulations, the MATCH Hospitality Sales Regulations, Additional Terms and other requirements of the Application Process.”
17.2 “Additional Terms” means the Ticket GTCs and the Stadium Code of Conduct (as amended from time to time).
17.3 “Application Process“ means the online application process under which the Customer applies for Hospitality Packages on the Website.
17.4 “Customer” means any legal entity or individual who purchases a Hospitality Package from WeBook.
17.5 “The AFC” means the Asian Football Confederation (the AFC), the world governing body of Association Football in Asia.

17.6 “The AFC Authority” means any out of the AFC, the LOC, the AFC Ticketing Centre, the AFC Ticketing Office, the Stadium management and/or any Saudi governmental entity responsible for safety and security in connection with the Matches, and their respective employees, volunteers, agents, representatives, officers and directors.

17.7 “Force Majeure Event” shall mean any event or circumstances which is beyond the control of MATCH Hospitality, the AFC, the LOC or another the AFC Authority including but not limited to a storm, earthquake, flood or other act of God, war, invasion, act of foreign enemy, hostilities (whether war be declared or not), civil war or strife, riot, national state of emergency, plague, act of terrorism, rebellion, strikes, lock-outs or other industrial disputes, acts of governments or other prevailing authorities, or any requirement, whether operational, organisational or other, of any the AFC Authority.
17.8 “Guest” means any individual invited by the Customer and to whom a Customer provides a Hospitality Package which has been sold to the Customer by WeBook.

17.9 “Hospitality Access Pass” means the pass, badge, wristband or other device issued by MATCH Hospitality which identifies the holder and will seek to entitle the holder (being only the Customer or a Guest) to access Hospitality Facilities.

17.10 “Hospitality Facility” means any location or facility at the site of a Stadium to which Customers and Guests are admitted, by virtue of the rights afforded by a Hospitality Package, to enjoy the provision of official AFC Asian Cup Saudi Arabia 2027™ hospitality services and benefits.

17.11 “Hospitality Package” means any official hospitality package created by MATCH Hospitality and sold by WeBook comprising a Ticket and certain Match-day hospitality benefits and services to be provided at any Hospitality Facility in connection with the AFC Asian Cup Saudi Arabia 2027™. Hospitality Packages do not include services or benefits provided other than at a Hospitality Facility, such as (without limitation) ground transportation, air travel or accommodation services.
17.12 “LOC” means the organising committee of the AFC Asian Cup Saudi Arabia 2027™.
17.13 “Match” means any football match scheduled to comprise the AFC Asian Cup Saudi Arabia 2027™ football tournament.

17.14 “MATCH Hospitality” is MATCH Hospitality Asia which is the trading name of Byrom Public Limited Company, a company registered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia with commercial registration number: 26307064 with its address at Riyadh, Al Zahra, Ibn Hubbira, 12815.
17.15 “Product Description” means the description of each Hospitality Package, or series of Hospitality Packages which are the subject of any transaction between the Customer and WeBook.
17.16 “Sales Regulations” means these regulations governing the sale through the Website and use of Hospitality Packages.

17.17 “Suite” means an elevated box or suite which is customarily an enclosed private or collective compartment inside the Stadium, with direct access to guests’ seats, which are separated from other seats in the Stadium.
17.18 “Stadium” means any stadium (including the entire surrounding and adjacent areas which are under the control of the AFC) at which a Match takes place.

17.19 “Stadium Code of Conduct” means the applicable safety and security measures adopted by the AFC, the LOC or any other the AFC Authority as reflected in the Stadium-specific code of conduct (and which shall be provided by the AFC from time to time).

17.20 “Ticket” means any physical device (in whatever form the AFC may decide) which is issued by the AFC (or a third party authorised by the AFC) and which entitles its holder to access the Stadium on a Match day and to view a Match “live” and in person from a seat.

17.21 “Ticket GTCs” means the AFC Asian Cup Saudi Arabia 2027™ General Terms and Conditions for the Use of Tickets, representing the general terms and conditions issued by the AFC which apply to the use of any and all Tickets, which are, among others, binding on, and enforceable against, any person purchasing, holding or using a Ticket, including any Ticket being part of a Hospitality Package.
17.22 “Website” means www.webook.com where potential Customers can purchase Hospitality Packages for the AFC Asian Cup Saudi Arabia 2027™ from WeBook.

17.23 “WeBook” means Halla Yalla IT Company (trading as “WeBook”), with its principal place of business at 7424 Takhassussi, Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, with company registration number 1010766766.

seo.title: Hospitality Experience | China Package – 3 Group Stage Matches
seo.description:
Follow My Team – China (3 Group Matches)

Be part of history as Saudi Arabia hosts the AFC Asian Cup for the very first time! This package gives you the chance to witness China's national team in action across all three of their group stage matches. The tournament runs from January 7 to February 5, 2027, across the host cities of Riyadh, Jeddah, and Al Khobar — making it an unforgettable experience for Chinese football fans traveling to Saudi Arabia. Cheer on China and make memories that will last a lifetime!

event_ticket.description:
Celebrate in a festive shared hospitality lounge within the stadium. 

 

MATCH Club Gold includes: 

Shared hospitality lounge in the stadium​ 

Convenient access to prime-view seating

In-lounge entertainment. Match-day broadcast on TV’s within the lounge 

Casual grazing style menus with a focus on football food and street food 

Inclusive beverage selection of soft drinks, coffee and teas 

Service (before, during halftime and after the match)*

Dedicated hospitality hosts to welcome and guide you at the venue 

Commemorative gift 

Priority access and parking subject to availability 

 

* Opening 3 hours before match kick-off and closing 1 hour after the final whistle

data.title: Hospitality Experience | China Package – 3 Group Stage Matches
data.description:
Live The Tournament with Chaina Team!
Immerse yourself in the tournament atmosphere with China’s package.
Attend three matches with a hospitality experience that combines comfort and excitement throughout the matches.

China vs Iran - Jan 9
Stadium: Kingdom Arena, Riyadh

China vs Syria - Jan 14
Stadium: Prince Abdullah Al Faisal Stadium, Jeddah

China vs Kyrgyzstan - Jan 18
Stadium: Kingdom Arena, Riyadh

MATCH Hospitality Asia will deliver the Official Hospitality Programme for the AFC Asian Cup Saudi Arabia 2027TM.

Secure your place in Official Hospitality and enjoy an elevated experience at the tournament:

- Extended hospitality service 

- Exceptional pitch views

- Priority access through dedicated hospitality gates and entrances

- An elegant menu of starters, mezze, main courses and selection of complementing dishes including refined dessert items.

- Dedicated Hospitality entertainment and match broadcasts

- Commemorative gift

- Parking

 

Click ‘Book Hospitality Tickets’ to see Hospitality Product Inclusions and pricing.

 

For more information please contact:

enquiries@match-asia.com

+966 55 337 3117

content.value: In purchasing this ticket, you agree to abide by all the terms and conditions and adhere to any other responsible terms and conditions or restrictions provided by the organizer before or during the event:
Open gate : 8:30 PM
Start Concert: 9:30 PM
Every attendee must purchase a separate ticket.
The Age allowed is 15 years and older.
Tickets prices are non-refundable.
In case of event cancellation, postponing or changing the date by the event organizer, the ticket price will be refunded.

The ticket holder is solely responsible for checking the date, time, location, and the age restriction of the event. Early arrival is a must, and the organizer shall have the right to refuse any late entries, and the ticket holder shall not have the right to claim for a refund of the ticket price or any compensation whatsoever.

The ticket purchaser acknowledges that the event organizer has the right to add, modify, or replace any artistic segments, accompanying performances, emerging talents, or guest artists within the event program without the prior consent of the ticket holder. Such changes shall not constitute a material change to the event, provided that the main advertised artist remains part of the performance. Accordingly, the ticket holder shall not be entitled to request a refund or compensation unless the organizer decides otherwise at its sole discretion or as required under applicable laws and regulations.

The event organizer reserves the right to change the start time of the concert or rearrange the event schedule whenever deemed necessary for the benefit of the event or due to organizational, technical, or operational reasons. Such changes shall not be considered a cancellation of the event nor entitle the ticket holder to a refund, provided that the event takes place on the same date and at the same advertised venue, unless the organizer decides otherwise or applicable laws and regulations require otherwise.
In case of leaving the venue, you are not allowed to return.

All tickets holders and their belongings may be subject to search when entering the venue. Prohibited and dangerous items will be confiscated. Any item which the organizer or venue security personnel consider as security risk or that may be used to damage the venue or interfere with the event will be confiscated.
Food and beverages from outside are not allowed. Food trucks will be available.
Animals are not allowed.
No professional cameras and video recorders are permitted at the venue.
The ticket holder consents to photographs, video, audio recordings of ticket holder be captured and used in printed and electronics media, including the internet as an attendee at the venue.
Smoking is strictly prohibited on the premises, including e-cigarettes. The use of lighters and matches is also prohibited inside the site, except in areas designated for smoking.

The organizer accepts no liability for bodily injury, illness, or death of any visitor (including ticket holder) and / or loss of or damage to personal effects arising out of or in connection with the event.
The organizer has the right to remove whoever commits an act that, in the opinion of the organizer, is a contrary behavior.
Adherence to the rules of public taste in line with the culture, values, and tradition of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
Adherence to Modest Clothing
It is required to comply with the general guidelines and dress code rules as per the Public Decency Regulations. These guidelines include:

- Clothing should not be transparent, body-colored, or tight to the point of revealing body details.  
- Wearing clothing that has phrases, images, or patterns that are offensive to public morals, or showing tattoos that conflict with public decency is prohibited.  
- Clothing with phrases, images, or patterns that promote racism, divisive ideologies, drug use, or obscenity should not be worn.  
- Wearing underwear, sleepwear, or similar items as outerwear is not permitted.  
- Clothing should not be tight in sensitive areas; if tight clothing is necessary for presentation, the sensitive areas must be covered with additional fabric in both the front and back to ensure they are not visible.  
- For women, clothing should be at least knee-length.  
- Sleeves should cover the chest, back, and shoulders for women.  
- Wearing inappropriate clothing is prohibited. Clothing rules should follow the example set in the Public Decency Regulations under Ministerial Resolution No. 10166 by the Ministry of Interior.
These rules aim to preserve public morals and mutual respect within the community. Adherence to such standards reflects the values of society and promotes positive behavior.

items.id: Live the World Cup: The Grand Final with Benchmark
items.title: Live the World Cup: The Grand Final with Benchmark

content.value: Experience the excitement of the World Cup like never before at “Live the World Cup” inside Abadi Aljohar Arena ⚽🔥

Giant screens, interactive zones, challenges and prizes, an unforgettable fan atmosphere, restaurants & cafés, and a football experience that keeps the excitement alive from the first whistle to the final minute.
Whether you’re coming with friends or family, this is where you’ll truly live the World Cup spirit in the heart of Jeddah’s vibrant atmosphere.
Book your ticket now and get ready for one of Saudi Arabia’s biggest football fan gatherings.

schedule.title: Live the World Cup: The Grand Final with Benchmark

content.value: In purchasing this ticket, you agree to abide by all the terms and conditions and adhere to any other responsible terms and conditions or restrictions provided by the organizer before or during the event:
Open gate 6:00 PM
Start match 10:00 PM
Every attendee must purchase a separate ticket.
The Age allowed is 6 years and older.
Tickets prices are non-refundable.
In case of event cancellation, postponing or changing the date by the event organizer, the ticket price will be refunded.

The ticket holder is solely responsible for checking the date, time, location, and the age restriction of the event. Early arrival is a must, and the organizer shall have the right to refuse any late entries, and the ticket holder shall not have the right to claim for a refund of the ticket price or any compensation whatsoever.
In case of leaving the venue, you are not allowed to return.

All tickets holders and their belongings may be subject to search when entering the venue. Prohibited and dangerous items will be confiscated. Any item which the organizer or venue security personnel consider as security risk or that may be used to damage the venue or interfere with the event will be confiscated.
Food and beverages from outside are not allowed. Food trucks will be available.
Animals are not allowed.
No professional cameras and video recorders are permitted at the venue.
The ticket holder consents to photographs, video, audio recordings of ticket holder be captured and used in printed and electronics media, including the internet as an attendee at the venue.

The organizer accepts no liability for bodily injury, illness, or death of any visitor (including ticket holder) and / or loss of or damage to personal effects arising out of or in connection with the event.
The organizer has the right to remove whoever commits an act that, in the opinion of the organizer, is a contrary behavior.
Adherence to the rules of public taste in line with the culture, values, and tradition of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
Adherence to Modest Clothing
It is required to comply with the general guidelines and dress code rules as per the Public Decency Regulations. These guidelines include:

- Clothing should not be transparent, body-colored, or tight to the point of revealing body details.  
- Wearing clothing that has phrases, images, or patterns that are offensive to public morals, or showing tattoos that conflict with public decency is prohibited.  
- Clothing with phrases, images, or patterns that promote racism, divisive ideologies, drug use, or obscenity should not be worn.  
- Wearing underwear, sleepwear, or similar items as outerwear is not permitted.  
- Clothing should not be tight in sensitive areas; if tight clothing is necessary for presentation, the sensitive areas must be covered with additional fabric in both the front and back to ensure they are not visible.  
- For women, clothing should be at least knee-length.  
- Sleeves should cover the chest, back, and shoulders for women.  
- Wearing inappropriate clothing is prohibited. Clothing rules should follow the example set in the Public Decency Regulations under Ministerial Resolution No. 10166 by the Ministry of Interior.
These rules aim to preserve public morals and mutual respect within the community. Adherence to such standards reflects the values of society and promotes positive behavior.

The ticket purchaser acknowledges that the event organizer has the right to add, modify, or replace any artistic segments, accompanying performances, emerging talents, or guest artists within the event program without the prior consent of the ticket holder. Such changes shall not be considered a material change to the event as long as the main advertised artist remains part of the performance. Accordingly, the ticket holder shall not be entitled to request a refund or compensation, unless the organizer decides otherwise at its sole discretion or as required under applicable laws and regulations.

The event organizer reserves the right to change the start time of the concert or rearrange the event schedule whenever deemed necessary for the benefit of the event or due to organizational, technical, or operational reasons. Such changes shall not be considered a cancellation of the event nor entitle the ticket holder to a refund, provided that the event takes place on the same date and at the same advertised venue, unless the organizer decides otherwise or applicable laws and regulations require otherwise.

content.value: In purchasing this ticket, you agree to abide by all the terms and conditions and adhere to any other responsible terms and conditions or restrictions provided by the organizer before or during the event:
Open gate : 8:00 PM
Start Concert: 10:00 PM
Every attendee must purchase a separate ticket.
The Age allowed is 12 years and older.
Tickets prices are non-refundable.
In case of event cancellation, postponing or changing the date by the event organizer, the ticket price will be refunded.

The ticket holder is solely responsible for checking the date, time, location, and the age restriction of the event. Early arrival is a must, and the organizer shall have the right to refuse any late entries, and the ticket holder shall not have the right to claim for a refund of the ticket price or any compensation whatsoever.

The ticket purchaser acknowledges that the event organizer has the right to add, modify, or replace any artistic segments, accompanying performances, emerging talents, or guest artists within the event program without the prior consent of the ticket holder. Such changes shall not constitute a material change to the event, provided that the main advertised artist remains part of the performance. Accordingly, the ticket holder shall not be entitled to request a refund or compensation unless the organizer decides otherwise at its sole discretion or as required under applicable laws and regulations.

The event organizer reserves the right to change the start time of the concert or rearrange the event schedule whenever deemed necessary for the benefit of the event or due to organizational, technical, or operational reasons. Such changes shall not be considered a cancellation of the event nor entitle the ticket holder to a refund, provided that the event takes place on the same date and at the same advertised venue, unless the organizer decides otherwise or applicable laws and regulations require otherwise.
In case of leaving the venue, you are not allowed to return.

All tickets holders and their belongings may be subject to search when entering the venue. Prohibited and dangerous items will be confiscated. Any item which the organizer or venue security personnel consider as security risk or that may be used to damage the venue or interfere with the event will be confiscated.
Food and beverages from outside are not allowed. Food trucks will be available.
Animals are not allowed.
No professional cameras and video recorders are permitted at the venue.
The ticket holder consents to photographs, video, audio recordings of ticket holder be captured and used in printed and electronics media, including the internet as an attendee at the venue.
Smoking is strictly prohibited on the premises, including e-cigarettes. The use of lighters and matches is also prohibited inside the site, except in areas designated for smoking.

The organizer accepts no liability for bodily injury, illness, or death of any visitor (including ticket holder) and / or loss of or damage to personal effects arising out of or in connection with the event.
The organizer has the right to remove whoever commits an act that, in the opinion of the organizer, is a contrary behavior.
Adherence to the rules of public taste in line with the culture, values, and tradition of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
Adherence to Modest Clothing
It is required to comply with the general guidelines and dress code rules as per the Public Decency Regulations. These guidelines include:

- Clothing should not be transparent, body-colored, or tight to the point of revealing body details.  
- Wearing clothing that has phrases, images, or patterns that are offensive to public morals, or showing tattoos that conflict with public decency is prohibited.  
- Clothing with phrases, images, or patterns that promote racism, divisive ideologies, drug use, or obscenity should not be worn.  
- Wearing underwear, sleepwear, or similar items as outerwear is not permitted.  
- Clothing should not be tight in sensitive areas; if tight clothing is necessary for presentation, the sensitive areas must be covered with additional fabric in both the front and back to ensure they are not visible.  
- For women, clothing should be at least knee-length.  
- Sleeves should cover the chest, back, and shoulders for women.  
- Wearing inappropriate clothing is prohibited. Clothing rules should follow the example set in the Public Decency Regulations under Ministerial Resolution No. 10166 by the Ministry of Interior.
These rules aim to preserve public morals and mutual respect within the community. Adherence to such standards reflects the values of society and promotes positive behavior.

content.value: Najma’s Dreams” is an entertaining family theatre production that takes children on a magical journey filled with adventure, imagination, and exciting moments. Najma enters the world of dreams, where she meets amusing characters and faces challenges that help her discover the power of courage, friendship, and determination.

Presented in a fun and engaging style, the play delivers positive educational messages and encourages children to believe in themselves, overcome their fears, and hold on to their dreams. It is a joyful theatrical experience filled with fantasy, laughter, and excitement.

content.value: 1. Each ticket is valid for one person only and may not be copied, duplicated, or reused.
2. The recommended age group for the play is 7 to 14 years.
3. Please arrive at least 30 minutes before the performance begins. Entry after the start of the show may not be permitted, subject to the venue's admission policy.
4. Tickets are non-refundable and non-exchangeable, except in the event of cancellation by the organizer.
5. Guests must present their electronic ticket or entry QR code at the venue entrance.
6. Children must remain under the supervision and responsibility of their parent or accompanying adult at all times while at the theater.
7. Outside food and beverages are not permitted unless allowed under the venue's policy.
8. Flash photography and full recording of the performance are prohibited without prior approval from the organizer.
9. The organizer reserves the right to refuse entry to, or remove, any person who causes disruption or fails to comply with venue rules and safety instructions.
10. The event may be photographed or recorded for promotional and media purposes. By attending, guests consent to appearing in general event footage.
11. The organizer reserves the right to modify the performance schedule or program when necessary and will notify ticket holders whenever possible.
12. In the event that the performance is postponed or canceled due to circumstances beyond the organizer's control, the refund or rescheduling policy of the ticketing platform will apply.

data.title: Najma Dreams
data.description:
Najma’s Dreams” is an entertaining family theatre production that takes children on a magical journey filled with adventure, imagination, and exciting moments. Najma enters the world of dreams, where she meets amusing characters and faces challenges that help her discover the power of courage, friendship, and determination.

Presented in a fun and engaging style, the play delivers positive educational messages and encourages children to believe in themselves, overcome their fears, and hold on to their dreams. It is a joyful theatrical experience filled with fantasy, laughter, and excitement.

content.value: Ticket Terms & Conditions:
By purchasing this ticket, the ticket holder agrees to comply with all terms, conditions, and restrictions set by the organizer before or during the event.
First: General Rules
Free admission for children under one (1) year old.
A separate ticket must be purchased for every individual (adult or child over one year old).
All payments are non-refundable.
The only official platform for ticket resale is Webook.com

If a ticket is sold or purchased outside the Webook.com platform, the organizer reserves the right to cancel the ticket with no compensation or refund. Permanently close the buyer’s account responsible for the violation. Take legal action in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

In case of cancellation or rescheduling due to legal, security, natural disasters, or circumstances beyond the organizer’s control, tickets will remain valid for the new date as announced by the relevant authorities.
Second: Entry and Attendance
It is the ticket holder's responsibility to check the event date, time, venue, and age restrictions before attending.
Ticket holders must arrive early at the venue.
The organizer reserves the right to deny entry to latecomers without compensation or refund.
No re-entry is allowed after leaving the venue.
Exception: Medical emergencies, subject to field approval from the event organizer.
All attendees and their personal belongings are subject to search upon entry.
Prohibited or dangerous items, or any items deemed a threat by the organizer or security, will be confiscated.
Third: Prohibited Items and Actions
Outside food and drinks are strictly prohibited.
Food and beverage vendors will be available inside the venue.
Bringing perfume bottles into the venue is prohibited and will be disposed of at the entrance.
No pets or animals are allowed inside the venue.
Professional cameras and recording equipment are not allowed without prior written approval.
Smoking, including electronic cigarettes, is prohibited except in designated smoking areas.
Lighters and matches are not allowed inside the venue except in designated areas.
Fourth: Conduct and Liability
The organizer reserves the right to remove any individual engaging in disruptive or inappropriate behavior.
Attendees must adhere to public decency laws in accordance with the culture and values of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
The organizer assumes no responsibility for injuries, illnesses, death, or loss/damage of personal property resulting from or related to attendance at the event.
By attending the event, the ticket holder grants the organizer the right to use photographs, video footage, and audio recordings for publication or promotional purposes.
Fifth: Fans and Seating
The organizer reserves the right to deny entry or remove individuals seated in areas designated for the opposing team’s supporters.
No refunds or compensation will be provided in such cases.
Attendees must wear attire supporting the team for the section they booked tickets for.
Entry will be denied to individuals wearing the rival team’s attire.
Sixth: Accessible Tickets (People with Disabilities)
These tickets are strictly for individuals with physical disabilities (mobility impairment).
A valid government-issued disability card must be presented at entry.
Companions will not be allowed entry without the presence of the person with a disability.
If the information or documentation provided is incorrect, entry will be denied.
Accessible tickets are limited and allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.
Accessible tickets will be reviewed and approved by the organizer and club management, and sent to the customer 24 hours prior to the match.
Seventh: Pricing, Seating, and Responsibilities
The organizer has the exclusive right to increase or decrease ticket prices.
The organizer will follow the club’s official policy regarding whether a price difference will be compensated or not.
The organizer reserves the right to relocate ticket holders based on directives or in case of emergencies.
If a customer is moved to a lower-priced category, the organizer will inform the customer and clarify the compensation process for the price difference, if applicable, based on the club’s
Eighth: Webook.com is not responsible for any organizational issues such as:
Poor parking management.
Any administrative failures within the venue or stadium.
These responsibilities rest solely with the event organizer.
