data.description:
Be part of a special moment at Al Awwal Park ✨
Join our “Photo with the Trophy” 🏆
Event for the Seasonal and Diamond Membership holders—ready to capture your photo?

📅 Date:
July 29–30
Enjoy a fun and easy photo experience with the event trophy and make it a one of a kind memory.

Ticket Terms & Conditions:

By purchasing this ticket, the ticket holder agrees to comply with all terms, conditions, and restrictions set by the organizer before or during the event.

First: General Rules

  • Free admission for children under one (1) year old.

  • A separate ticket must be purchased for every individual (adult or child over one year old).
  • All payments are non-refundable.

  • The only official platform for ticket resale is Webook.com

  • If a ticket is sold or purchased outside the Webook.com platform, the organizer reserves the right to cancel the ticket with no compensation or refund. Permanently close the buyer’s account responsible for the violation.Take legal action in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

  • In case of cancellation or rescheduling due to legal, security, natural disasters, or circumstances beyond the organizer’s control, tickets will remain valid for the new date as announced by the relevant authorities.

Second: Entry and Attendance

  • It is the ticket holder's responsibility to check the event date, time, venue, and age restrictions before attending.
  • Ticket holders must arrive early at the venue.
  • The organizer reserves the right to deny entry to latecomers without compensation or refund.
  • No re-entry is allowed after leaving the venue.
  • Exception: Medical emergencies, subject to field approval from the event organizer.
  • All attendees and their personal belongings are subject to search upon entry.
  • Prohibited or dangerous items, or any items deemed a threat by the organizer or security, will be confiscated.

Third: Prohibited Items and Actions

  • Outside food and drinks are strictly prohibited.
  • Food and beverage vendors will be available inside the venue.
  • Bringing perfume bottles into the venue is prohibited and will be disposed of at the entrance.
  • No pets or animals are allowed inside the venue.
  • Professional cameras and recording equipment are not allowed without prior written approval.
  • Smoking, including electronic cigarettes, is prohibited except in designated smoking areas.
  • Lighters and matches are not allowed inside the venue except in designated areas.

Fourth: Conduct and Liability

  • The organizer reserves the right to remove any individual engaging in disruptive or inappropriate behavior.
  • Attendees must adhere to public decency laws in accordance with the culture and values of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
  • The organizer assumes no responsibility for injuries, illnesses, death, or loss/damage of personal property resulting from or related to attendance at the event.
  • By attending the event, the ticket holder grants the organizer the right to use photographs, video footage, and audio recordings for publication or promotional purposes.

Fifth: Fans and Seating

  • The organizer reserves the right to deny entry or remove individuals seated in areas designated for the opposing team’s supporters.
  • No refunds or compensation will be provided in such cases.
  • Attendees must wear attire supporting the team for the section they booked tickets for.
  • Entry will be denied to individuals wearing the rival team’s attire.

Sixth: Accessible Tickets (People with Disabilities)

 

  • These tickets are strictly for individuals with physical disabilities (mobility impairment).
  • A valid government-issued disability card must be presented at entry.
  • Companions will not be allowed entry without the presence of the person with a disability.
  • If the information or documentation provided is incorrect, entry will be denied.
  • Accessible tickets are limited and allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.
  • Accessible tickets will be reviewed and approved by the organizer and club management, and sent to the customer 24 hours prior to the match.

Seventh: Pricing, Seating, and Responsibilities

  • The organizer has the exclusive right to increase or decrease ticket prices.
  • The organizer will follow the club’s official policy regarding whether a price difference will be compensated or not.
  • The organizer reserves the right to relocate ticket holders based on directives or in case of emergencies.
  • If a customer is moved to a lower-priced category, the organizer will inform the customer and clarify the compensation process for the price difference, if applicable, based on the club’s

Eighth: Webook.com is not responsible for any organizational issues such as:

  • Poor parking management.
  • Any administrative failures within the venue or stadium.
  • These responsibilities rest solely with the event organizer.

 

  • For the full Terms & Conditions please click here

items.description: The outdoor swimming pool at InterContinental Riyadh offers a refined oasis surrounded by lush landscaped gardens and swaying palm trees, creating an atmosphere of tranquility and exclusivity. Equipped with a temperature-controlled heating and cooling system, the pool ensures exceptional comfort throughout the year. Guests can unwind on elegant sun loungers, retreat to private gazebos, or enjoy stylish outdoor dining and lounge seating. A curated selection of premium food and beverages is available poolside, delivering a sophisticated leisure experience in an elegant open-air setting.

content.value: Palm Fitness Club – Membership Terms & Conditions
1. Membership Fees
All membership fees are non-refundable and non-transferable once payment has been completed.
2. Membership Eligibility
Membership is available only to individuals who are sixteen (16) years of age or older.
Palm Fitness Club reserves the right to request valid identification to verify a member's age at any time.
Members under the age of eighteen (18) may be required to provide parental or legal guardian consent in accordance with applicable laws and club policies.
3. Membership Activation
Members must activate their membership within fifteen (15) days from the date of purchase.
Failure to activate the membership within this period will result in the membership being automatically activated on the sixteenth (16th) day.
The membership validity period shall commence from the activation date, whether activated by the member or automatically by the system.
4. Force Majeure

Palm Fitness Club shall not be held liable for any modification, interruption, postponement, or cancellation of services due to circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including but not limited to natural disasters, government actions, public health emergencies, power outages, or other force majeure events.
5. Compliance with Club Policies
By entering the club premises, members and guests agree to comply with all club rules, policies, safety requirements, and instructions issued by management and staff.
6. Management Rights
Palm Fitness Club reserves the right to amend operating hours, facilities, classes, services, and membership policies at its sole discretion.
7. Acceptance of Terms
By purchasing a membership, making a reservation, or using the club facilities, members acknowledge that they have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms & Conditions.
